name: Az Sainklaus
original_name: アズ・セインクラウス
source: A runaway girl whose journey carried her to Military Academy 30. 16 years old. A string of coincidences results in her joining the crew of the Cutting-Edge All-Purpose Military Combat Mothership Dreisstrager as the pilot of the Huckebein 30. She is taciturn and rarely tries to interact with others, but also never refuses someone who tries to reach out to her. Her history before joining the Dreisstrager is unclear and she refuses to speak about her own past, but her piloting skils suggest she must have undergone specialized training.
